card.name: Inside names split at "arg"
card.fires_on: Mostly the piece "arg" (or "ARG", "Arg") inside longer names such as sargramostim, argatroban or Kargere's. Also fires weakly on a few linking words like "also", "be" and "is" after "can" or "this plant".

modes.label: arg inside names
modes.description: The letters "arg" start or sit inside a drug or proper name that is split into pieces.

modes.label: Small words after can
modes.description: A short linking word right after "can" or a subject in a descriptive clause.
modes.example: Serotonin syndrome can<< also>> occur when these drugs are used alone.

modes.label: Hyphen or abbreviation piece
modes.description: A hyphen or "g" in a drug-class or "e.g." abbreviation.
modes.example: at any time after starting treatment with a LAG<<->>3 and PD-1/PD-L
